mapper.sql: refund.refund_id, refund.refund_reference, refund.order_id, refund.original_reference, refund.merchant_reference, refund.idempotency_key, refund.psp_refund_reference, currency.currency_code AS currency, refund.created_ts
JOIN merchant_order o ON o.order_id = refund.order_id JOIN currency ON currency.currency_id = o.currency_id

refund_item.refund_item_id, refund_item.refund_id, refund_item.refund_failed, item.order_item_id, item.order_id, product_type.code AS product_type, item.order_line_reference, item.merchant_line_reference, item.net_amount, item.tax_amount, item.tax_rate
JOIN order_item item ON item.order_item_id = refund_item.order_item_id JOIN product_type ON product_type.product_type_id = item.product_type_id
mapper.select: WITH refund AS ( INSERT INTO merchant_refund ( refund_reference, order_id, original_reference, merchant_reference, idempotency_key, psp_refund_reference, created_ts ) VALUES ( #{refundReference}, #{orderId}, #{originalReference}, #{merchantReference}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{pspRefundReference,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, now() ) RETURNING * ) SELECT FROM refund

WITH refund_item AS ( INSERT INTO refund_item (refund_id, order_item_id) VALUES (#{refundId}, #{orderItemId}) ON CONFLICT (order_item_id) WHERE NOT refund_failed DO NOTHING RETURNING * ) SELECT FROM refund_item

SELECT FROM merchant_refund refund
WHERE refund.original_reference = #{originalReference} ORDER BY refund.refund_id

SELECT FROM refund_item
WHERE refund_item.refund_id = #{refundId} ORDER BY refund_item.refund_item_id

SELECT FROM refund_item JOIN merchant_refund refund ON refund.refund_id = refund_item.refund_id
WHERE refund.original_reference = #{originalReference} ORDER BY refund_item.refund_id, refund_item.refund_item_id
mapper.update: UPDATE refund_item SET refund_failed = true FROM merchant_refund refund WHERE refund.refund_id = refund_item.refund_id AND refund.refund_reference = #{refundReference} AND NOT refund_item.refund_failed
